nodes.name: Fetch YouTube Transcript
nodes.notes:
CREDENTIAL SETUP:
1. Go to supadata.ai and create free account (100 req/month free)
2. Copy your API key
3. In n8n Credentials, create 'Header Auth'
   Name: Supadata API Key
   Header Name: x-api-key
   Header Value: YOUR_SUPADATA_API_KEY

nodes.name: Generate LinkedIn Posts
nodes.notes:
CREDENTIAL SETUP:
1. Go to openrouter.ai, create account, get API key
2. Create 'Header Auth' credential in n8n:
   Name: OpenRouter API Key
   Header Name: Authorization
   Header Value: ADD_YOUR_API_KEY

Model used: mistral-7b-instruct (free tier available)
Change to 'openai/gpt-4o' for better quality

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  model: 'openai/gpt-oss-120b:free',
  max_tokens: 2000,
  messages: [
    {
      role: 'system',
      content: 'You are a Twitter/X viral content expert. Write punchy, provocative threads. Tweet 1 is always the hook. Tweets 2-4 are evidence. Tweet 5 is the takeaway. EACH TWEET UNDER 270 CHARACTERS. IMPORTANT LANGUAGE RULE: If the transcript is in Hindi, you MUST write the threads in Hinglish (a highly conversational mix of Hindi and English written entirely in the Roman alphabet/English letters). Do NOT use Devanagari script. If the transcript is in English, write in pure English.'
    },
    {
      role: 'user',
      content: 'Based on this YouTube transcript, write EXACTLY 3 Twitter threads. Each thread has EXACTLY 5 tweets. Format EXACTLY like this:

THREAD1:
Tweet1: [content - max 270 chars]
Tweet2: [content - max 270 chars]
Tweet3: [content - max 270 chars]
Tweet4: [content - max 270 chars]
Tweet5: [content - max 270 chars]

THREAD2:
Tweet1: [content]
Tweet2: [content]
Tweet3: [content]
Tweet4: [content]
Tweet5: [content]

THREAD3:
Tweet1: [content]
Tweet2: [content]
Tweet3: [content]
Tweet4: [content]
Tweet5: [content]

Transcript:
' + $json.transcript
    }
  ]
} }}

nodes.name: Review Log
nodes.notes:
IMPORTANT: Check execution logs here!
All posts are printed for your review.
If anything looks bad - stop the workflow.
To add human approval: replace this node with a 'Wait' node set to 'Wait for webhook'
